Description: Right extends to causing death when assault causes reasonable apprehension of death or grievous hurt or certain offences.

Title: When such right extends to causing any harm other than death
Description: Right extends to causing any harm other than death in other cases of assault.
Punishment: Causing harm permitted

Title: Commencement and continuance of right of private defence of body
Description: Right commences when reasonable apprehension arises; continues while apprehension continues.

Title: When right of private defence of property extends to causing death

Title: When such right extends to causing harm other than death
Description: Right extends to causing harm other than death in theft or criminal trespass to movable property.

Title: Commencement and continuance of right of private defence of property

Description: Definition of abettor - person who abets the doing of a thing.

Title: Concealing design to commit offence punishable with imprisonment
Description: Concealing design to commit offence punishable with imprisonment.

Title: Criminal conspiracy
Description: Definition of criminal conspiracy - when two or more persons agree to do illegal act or legal act by illegal means.
Punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both (minor); same as offence (serious)

Title: Criminal conspiracy - punishment
Description: Punishment of criminal conspiracy - conspiracy to commit offence punishable by death/life/2+ years: same as abetment. Otherwise: imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both.
Punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both if offence punishable with up to 2 years; otherwise same as offence

Title: Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment
Description: Attempt to commit offence punishable by up to half maximum imprisonment for offence or fine or both when no specific punishment.
Punishment: Up to 1/2 max imprisonment for offence

Title: Culpable homicide
Description: Whoever causes death by doing act with: intention of causing death; intention of causing bodily injury likely to cause death; knowledge that act likely to cause death.
Punishment: Punished as per Section 103 (culpable homicide not amounting to murder: imprisonment up to 10 years or life, and fine) or Section 104/105
Chapter: Chapter VI: Offences Affecting Human Body

Title: Murder
Description: Culpable homicide is murder when: act causing death done with intention of causing death; intention of causing bodily injury known likely to cause death; intention of causing bodily injury sufficient in ordinary course to cause death; knowing act so imminently dangerous it must cause death or bodily injury likely to cause death. Exceptions: grave sudden provocation, exceeding private defense, public servant exceeding powers, sudden fight without premeditation, adult consent.
